ar: عايز ملاحظة محدش يشوفها غير الفريق
en: Can I leave an internal note on a chat?

steps: Open a chat, press Notes and tags in the chat header
Write the note under Internal notes, press Add the note
The team sees every note on the chat; the customer never does
edgeCases: Notes are included in contact export and erasure
A note cannot be edited or deleted (irreversible)
A conversation id from another workspace answers 404
